notes: Panel rows are 21-24 of the 25-row screen and columns are 0-39; see assets.md, The screen.  Rows and columns here are zero-based and absolute.
Every string is stored with its padding spaces, because the highlight covers the padding: the selected item is that many cells of reverse video, leading and trailing space included.
The character names, descriptions and trait lines are in characters.json as `name`, `description` and `traits`; only their positions are here.

main_menu.cursor: up and down, clamped at both ends, no wrap

character_select.cursor: up only, cycling Neric, Genaa, Herd, Pomma, Charn, RETURN TO MENU, and back to Neric

line.text: SAVE GAME  LOAD GAME  RETURN TO MENU

disk_storage.cursor: left and right, clamped at both ends, no wrap

slots.cursor: left and right, clamped at both ends, no wrap

storage_prompt.note: the confirmation step: the button here commits the save or the load, and there is no way back to the slot line
